description: Tempo offline por dispositivo. Filtra quedas em massa (reinício coordenador/HA) e totais curtos (≤ N minutos).

options.content:
**Fonte:** métrica `device_availability` no Influx, mesma regra do *Dispositivos offline* no HA.

**Ruído filtrado:**
- **Queda em massa** — minutos com ≥ N dispositivos offline (reinício do HA/coordenador/Z2M) não entram no tempo.
- **Mín. minutos** — totais ≤ esse valor contam como zero e saem do ranking.

Ajusta os filtros no topo. A linha do tempo continua a mostrar o sinal bruto.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home_energy")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_availability" and r._field == "offline")
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "offline_now")

from(bucket: "home_energy")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_availability" and r._field == "online")
  |> last()
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "monitored")

import "join"

mins = from(bucket: "home_energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_availability" and r._field == "offline")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

counts = mins
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, n_offline: r._value}))
  |> group()

join.time(
  left: mins |> group(),
  right: counts,
  as: (l, r) => ({l with n_offline: r.n_offline}),
)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (not exists r.n_offline) or r.n_offline < int(v: "${mass_cut}"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value == 1 then 60.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> sum()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > float(v: "${min_offline_min}") * 60.0)
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "total_offline_s")

import "join"

mins = from(bucket: "home_energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_availability" and r._field == "offline")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

counts = mins
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, n_offline: r._value}))
  |> group()

join.time(
  left: mins |> group(),
  right: counts,
  as: (l, r) => ({l with n_offline: r.n_offline}),
)
  // Ignora minutos de "queda em massa" (reinício HA/coordenador/Z2M)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (not exists r.n_offline) or r.n_offline < int(v: "${mass_cut}"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value == 1 then 60.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> sum()
  // Corte: totais ≤ N minutos contam como zero (somem do ranking)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > float(v: "${min_offline_min}") * 60.0)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Tempo offline", device: "Dispositivo"})
  |> keep(columns: ["Dispositivo", "Tempo offline"])
  |> yield(name: "ranking")

import "join"

mins = from(bucket: "home_energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_availability" and r._field == "offline")

counts = mins
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, n_offline: r._value}))
  |> group()

join.time(
  left: mins |> group(),
  right: counts,
  as: (l, r) => ({l with n_offline: r.n_offline}),
)
  // Ignora minutos de "queda em massa" (reinício HA/coordenador/Z2M)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (not exists r.n_offline) or r.n_offline < int(v: "${mass_cut}"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value == 1 then 60.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> sum()
  // Corte: totais ≤ N minutos contam como zero (somem do ranking)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > float(v: "${min_offline_min}") * 60.0)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 15)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.device }))
  |> yield(name: "top15")

panels.description: 1 = offline, 0 = online. Legenda com o nome igual ao dashboard do HA (Área — Dispositivo).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home_energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_availability" and r._field == "offline")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${device:regex}" == ".*" then true else r.device =~ /${device:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.device }))
  |> yield(name: "offline")

panels.title: Linha do tempo — offline (1) / online (0)
